checks.title: Snapshot dates without original disclosure proof
checks.description: Raw legacy dates are retained for audit. As-of readers now use first observation, not the inferred filing deadline. Historical source filings still need to be recovered.

checks.title: Financial facts with unknown scope or availability
checks.description: These cannot support comparable, dated financial calculations.

checks.title: Filings with no established publication time
checks.description: Unknown timing must remain unknown in historical reconstruction.

checks.title: Dated filings still missing an issuer identity
checks.description: Unlinked filings cannot reach issuer-level analysis; identity repair is separate from a negative company assessment.

checks.title: Unresolved announcement-listing windows
checks.description: Successful retries or complete child windows can cover an older failure in the same stream. Unverified empty responses and gaps remain incomplete.

checks.title: Incomplete results discovery in the requested window
checks.description: Only proven-complete results listings are cached. Empty or blocked listings remain retryable.

checks.title: Current symbol identities without a complete results listing for this window
checks.description: Coverage must not depend on an order announcement. Some instruments may not report corporate results; eligibility needs explicit source classification.

checks.title: Announcement stream-days with no listing attempts
checks.description: No attempt is missing coverage, not a successful empty universe.

checks.title: Text-ready filings without usable extracted text
checks.description: ZIP containers are ready only when every PDF member has complete extracted text. Native results use their own parsing check.

checks.title: Announcement attachments awaiting complete text
checks.description: Includes undispatched downloads, partial text and OCR. Download-policy exclusions remain visible; analysis of available text alone does not prove full filing coverage.

checks.title: Extracted filings not scanned under the active rules
checks.description: A rule-version change creates explicit reprocessing work. Older evaluations are retained until their source is reread.

checks.title: Results filings awaiting download or parsing
checks.description: Discovered results must reach usable facts before this window is marked complete.

checks.title: Results filings not evaluated under active rules
Results without a comparable prior period
checks.description: A missing comparable is a data limitation, not a negative business verdict.

checks.title: Results disclosed outside the old four-month refresh schedule
checks.description: This measures why results discovery must run year-round, independently of commercial mentions. It does not mean all these filings were missed.

checks.title: Unverified split and bonus adjustments
checks.description: Returns crossing these actions must not be labelled verified.

checks.title: Daily prices with multiple stored versions
checks.description: Calculators must select the latest version once per security-day, never duplicate observations.

checks.title: Historical outcomes with multiple recomputations
checks.description: The effective review view selects the latest recomputation rather than the highest historical return.

summary.note: Processing completion is separate from historical-data completeness and predictive performance.
